title: Behavioral safety simulator for cost-optimizer configs
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Problem: Automated batching/caching proposals from the Cost Optimizer can save material $/token but occasionally produce subtle quality regressions for specific dialog patterns, system prompts, or downstream heuristics. We need a simulator-driven acceptance gate that predicts regression risk before recommending/auto-applying config changes and that drives progressive rollouts and automated rollback decisions.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A simulator harness that can run a proposed batching/caching profile on historical traffic and synthetic edge cases and output a quantified risk score (0-100) and descriptive delta metrics. 2) Acceptance rules: profiles with risk score <= 20% can be auto-apply; 20-50% require staged canary with human approval; >50% blocked. 3) The harness must surface at least three independent signal types: semantic fidelity (embedding similarity), behavioral delta (policy/response change rate), and user-facing latency/regret proxies. 4) Integration with rollout controller so rollback is automatically triggered if sentinel tests cross thresholds during canary. 5) Documentation and runbook for on-call and SRE teams.
implementation_notes: Design a lightweight replay simulator that replays anonymized historical requests against the new config in an isolated offline runtime. Components: 1) Traffic sampler that stratifies by customer, intent cluster, and sequence length. 2) Response comparator: compute embedding-based similarity (Cosine on model-agnostic sentence embeddings), token-level KL-like divergence, and a categorical classification rate for structured outputs. 3) Statistical tester: bootstrap paired-difference CIs and a Bayesian online change detector for early-stop on large deltas. 4) Synthetic edge generator: fuzzed prompts derived from golden families (assistants, code, multi-turn support) to stress known fragility modes. 5) Scoring combiner using weighted signals with tunable weights per workload. Store metrics in the console as per-route evaluation cards.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Offline simulation and scoring (this ticket). Phase 1: Shadow canary: ingest simulator-approved profiles into Dedicated dev pool; run shadow traffic for 48h. Phase 2: Gradual canary: 1% traffic for 6h -> 5% for 24h with sentinel checks. Phase 3: Progressive ramp to 50% with automatic rollback if any sentinel breaches thresholds. Human-in-the-loop approvals required for P0 customers and high-risk profiles. All changes logged to audit and linked to the originating recommender ticket.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for comparator metrics.
- Replay runs on two week historical shards (NYC, EU).
- Stratified bootstrap to compute 95% CIs for semantic similarity deltas.
- Bayesian online detector that signals if posterior probability of regression > 0.9.
- Manual human review on a sampled batch of 200 pairs for initial calibration.
- Integration smoke with rollout controller in staging.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: running full model in simulator gives most fidelity but is expensive; we will start with lightweight cross-model embeddings (tiny-embed) and cache responses for speed. We will benchmark simulator runtime and tune sample sizes to keep an offline run under 2 hours for a daily cadence. Privacy: uses anonymized request payloads and requires datasets to be vetted before ingestion.
open_questions: What default weights should we apply to semantic vs behavioral signals for general-purpose workloads?
Do we allow the Cost Optimizer to auto-apply for enterprise customers with SLAs disabled?
